Use of Proceeds: General corporate purposes Listing: None Conflict of Interest: Jefferies LLC, the broker-dealer subsidiary of Jefferies Financial Group Inc., is a member of FINRA and will participate in the distribution of the
                notes being offered hereby. Accordingly, the offering is subject to the provisions of FINRA Rule 5121 relating to conflicts of interest and will be conducted in accordance with the requirements of Rule 5121. See “Conflict of Interest.” The Notes will be our senior unsecured obligations and will rank equally with our other senior unsecured indebtedness. Investing in the Notes involves risks that are described in the “ Risk Factors ” section beginning on page PS-3 of this pricing supplement.
